title: Selected high-resolution showcase
selection_note: Selected showcase, not a random sample: among the five lowest UniSEM whole-slice CREMI scores in the native 1024-pixel EMNeuron volumes, this slice has the largest improvement over the matched µSAM result. No training or new neural inference was performed.
interpretation: On this selected full slice, the frozen first-stage UniSEM model has lower overall VOI and ARAND than µSAM. Colors correspond to ground-truth overlap; actual prediction boundaries and residual errors are retained.

provenance.evaluation: 2D, 8-connected component-pseudo for prediction and GT, minimum area 1; official ELF metrics
provenance.image_policy: Native pixels; no upsampling, smoothing or generated detail. One color per connected prediction instance, matched to its largest GT overlap.
provenance.pixel_spacing: Physical spacing is not recorded; the viewer uses a pixel ruler.
